requirements.notes: G8 and G9 are separate roadmap gates.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Expose the documented root, health, info, text, image, result, and restart REST routes.
requirements.notes: Route registration is in G7; full restart/lifecycle behavior is explicitly deferred to G8.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Accept Authorization Bearer API keys or X-API-Key for protected routes.
requirements.notes: Health/liveness remain public according to the implementation's documented health surface.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Accept text generation requests, including the documented max_new_tokens field and async result polling surface.
requirements.notes: CPU fake/stub inference proves HTTP mechanics only. Cold compile and async lifecycle acceptance belongs to G8.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Accept image_base64 JSON and multipart image requests with prompt options.
requirements.notes: CPU fixture parsing and fake/stub submission prove the REST contract; no live image generation is required by canonical text.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Expose /health/live, /health/ready, and /info with JSON health/runtime responses.
requirements.notes: Readiness is tested against an injected manager state and must not instantiate a model.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Expose the authenticated restart route and X-Restart-Secret gate.
requirements.notes: Full restart, graceful shutdown, and lifecycle semantics are G8 scope.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: Async/cold compile plus restart/lifecycle acceptance is G8, not G7.
requirements.notes: Only route/HTTP mechanics needed to prove the G7 surface are included here.

requirements.requirement_text_summary: PRIME/HOT acceptance is G9, not G7.
requirements.notes: No PRIME/HOT load or latency claims are made by G7.
